name: PR detail Files changed tab renders the Smart Diff view
description: PR #499 (spec .context/specs/08-smart-diff.md §6/§8) is seeded with files spanning all five Smart Diff roles and a review with findings in three of them. The Files changed tab renders the role-grouped, reviewer-ordered diff (DiffTab -> RoleGroup) instead of a flat file list: the section title, all five group headers, and the seeded CRITICAL finding inline under its cited line. Switching to Original order falls back to the flat pr.files list, revealing the boilerplate pnpm-lock.yaml that the grouped view keeps collapsed. Read-only seeded data (no model call). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).
